text:
Sam T.: running a local playbook for onboarding-sdk parity and hit flaky failures in the sampleapp streaming client where 429 resume tokens get double-applied after retry. noticed jitter was set to `none` in streaming path.

Jun W.: streaming path uses simpler retry because we assumed idempotency handled by server side. what's the exact failure?

Sam T.: when auth refresh causes transient 429s mid-stream, client side reconnect attempt replays buffered messages. with jitter none, multiple replicas in our load harness reconnected at same ms and sent the same buffered messages -> duplicates.

Logs:
```
INFO 2026-03-24T08:45:01Z stream_client: buffer_len=12 reconnecting due to 429
INFO 2026-03-24T08:45:01Z stream_client: retry attempt=1 backoff=0.01 jitter=0.0
INFO 2026-03-24T08:45:01Z stream_client: reconnect success
WARN 2026-03-24T08:45:01Z stream_client: processed duplicate message id=msg_aa12
```

Jun W.: we should unify streaming and request path jitter defaults. also stream client needs to tag each outgoing message with monotonic seq + optional `Idempotency-Key` for non-finalized side-effects.

Sam T.: proposal:
  - streaming: default jitter `full` and min_backoff 50ms
  - add `x-seq` header + `x-idempotency-key` to buffered messages when enabled
  - add `stream.safe_replay_window_ms` to client config to avoid replaying buffered messages older than window (defaults to 2000ms)

OpsBot: monitor/alerts: stream_dup_rate > 0.01% over 5m will page eng-runtime.

Jun W.: sending patch for streaming jitter and seq headers now. also adding an integration test in stream-integ that simulates auth key swap.

Sam T.: thanks. once landed i'll re-run the harness and share results. in the meantime i'll mute the alert for the staging cluster to avoid noise.

Jun W.: ack. mute set for 45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
